|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Tamizander Rey (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. Power and defense value + 2 at a docking bay. Your docking bay transit cost is - 3 for Rey and those moving with him.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a docking bay, power and defense value +2. Tamizander Rey’s docking bay transit requires -3 Force.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2. Power” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While at a docking bay, power”; “+ 2 at a docking bay. Your” → “+2. Tamizander Rey’s”; “cost is - 3 for Rey and those moving with him.” → “requires -3 Force.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 18. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Tamizander Rey]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Tamizander Rey (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Tamizander Rey]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_18.
